scope.view: same orthographic three-quarter right-facing view as EO walk
scope.future_equipment: interchangeable weapons in separate attachment tracks; no weapon pixels baked into first attack/jump body art

accepted_walk.acceptance_scope: User approved this walk baseline, one hero/view only

appearance_reference.role: AcceptedH3 walkframe00 with constant(+32,+64)padding; identity reference only, not new/approved neutral pose.

costume: silver shoulder armor and wrist bracers
shared_constraints.camera: fixed orthographic three-quarter right-facing; no mirrored new view
shared_constraints.registration: constant scale and shared camera/pivot; no per-pose fit, crop, scale or recenter
shared_constraints.materials: match approved walk palette, shading direction and crisp native pixel clusters; preserve trim and body-part mass
shared_constraints.framing_policy: NEW actions and neutral/transition art use fixed192x192, unchanged body paint scale, constant128-source padding(+32,+64), nominal ground pivot[96,170]. Accepted128 walk remains unchanged and aligns via its nominal ground pivot[64,106]. No per-pose root offset, fit or recenter. Verify new-pose extents and at least4px clear border.
shared_constraints.hidden_surfaces: Newly visible anatomy/cloth must be deliberately authored and qualified; walk cutouts do not recover it.
shared_constraints.weapons: Both first actions unarmed. Future modular weapon definitions may swap only within compatible body motion profiles and validated grip/occlusion contracts; punch is not automatically sword slash.

registration_measurement.qualification: Nominal pivots are registration anchors, not actual sole or flat-floor evidence. Padded bounds are calculation, not new art.

method_decision.recommended_first_experiment: camera-matched whole-action guide plus accepted hero appearance; gate strongest keys before completing clips

source_painted_parts.use: short arcs, costume/detail donor reuse, source-owned repairs
source_painted_parts.limit: not a full rig; missing underpaint and uncertain pelvis/knee seams do not supply attack/jump anatomy

new_authored_keys.limit: all keys and in-betweens need identity, adjacent-pair and timed review

full_motion_guide.use: explicit whole-body mechanics, contacts, root and height
full_motion_guide.limit: guide intent does not prove painted output follows it; provider transport/art/timing/contact/user acceptance are separate

method_decision.literal_edit_policy: retain source hashes, affected masks and donor coordinates; repair journals require replay, undo and outside-mask invariants; source changes invalidate dependent bakes/reviews

actions.aim: existing three-quarter right-facing depth line, not screen-right arm stretch

phases.name: anticipation
phases.reading: rear-leg/hip load; elbow retracts; torso prepares

phases.name: strike
phases.reading: accelerate to complete extension with coherent shoulder/fist arc

root_policy.later_lunge: separate collision-consumed root-motion variant; never sprite-origin slide

anchors.fist: separate pose-attached hitbox anchor with authored collision volume
anchors.weapon: no visible weapon; optional future grip/muzzle/tip anchors are independent equipment metadata
anchors.impact: spawn only on confirmed collision; own clock and termination

locks.movement_and_new_action: queue at most latest legal request; run after tick18
locks.retrigger: held button does not restart clip
locks.forced_interrupt: close hitbox immediately, clear owned effects, enter explicit supported hurt/death/reset state; missing art remains backlog

actions.completion: return to authored same-view neutral, or a supported startup transition into walk; never jump from fully extended fist to unrelated walk cel
actions.framing: Use shared192 stage; test complete fist reach/recoil and costume follow-through. Future weapon/tip/trail must fit at least4px inside same fixed stage or require deliberate whole-action framing-contract revision.

proposal.height_qualification: PROVISIONAL_FRAMING_PROPOSAL; choose runtime impulse/gravity consistently after units known

phases.name: takeoff
phases.reading: extend hips/knees and visibly leave support

phases.name: apex
phases.reading: read height reversal without freezing physics

phases.name: fall
phases.reading: extend for contact; maintain limb identity

root_policy.ground_root: stationary first pilot; owns ground plane collision/navigation/depth
root_policy.height: independent nonnegative airborne offset driven by physical vertical state
root_policy.render: project ground_root and height through same camera; simple screen-up height policy is projected root minus height minus pivot plus declared bias, round once
root_policy.shadow: optional independent ground-root layer; never follows airborne body
root_policy.land_time: actual descending collision, not nominal tick18
root_policy.airborne_selection: rise/apex/fall follow vertical state; do not wait at apex for timer

events.name: takeoff
events.trigger: once at authored release, set upward velocity/end ground support

events.name: apex_crossed
events.trigger: vertical velocity crosses upward to downward once

anchors.boots: declared takeoff and landing material/contact witnesses, not centroids alone
anchors.effects: optional takeoff dust and landing impact are world/ground-root instances with own clocks

locks.movement_and_attack: queue until landing recovery completes in first pilot
locks.repeat_jump: no double jump; holding input does not restart airborne state
locks.cancel: no voluntary airborne cancel in initial pilot
locks.forced_interrupt_reset: explicit physical state policy and effect cleanup; never teleport to idle midair

actions.completion: actual contact -> compression -> six-tick landing recovery -> authored neutral or supported walk startup
actions.framing: Use shared192 stage.16px nominal height would move measured rest top79 to63 before new pose deformation; test actual hair/raised hands/boots at every airborne phase. Ground-root remains stationary; no per-pose root offset.

adjacent_clip_dependencies.reason: Approved walk does not supply approved idle/guard; do not rename walk frame0 as idle

adjacent_clip_dependencies.review: guard/anticipation, extension/recoil, recovery/final neutral and one-shot replay seams

adjacent_clip_dependencies.first_pilot_policy: Stationary entries only; requests during walk defer to an explicitly supported exit and latency is measured
adjacent_clip_dependencies.later_arbitrary_phase_requirement: Finite supported transition bank for every permitted walk entry including fractional times; preserve root/collision/draw bias

adjacent_clip_dependencies.reason: Must exist before advertising those interruption/equipment routes

source_and_export: positive rational holds and explicit loop=false
each adjacent pose plus completion/replay/state endpoints
native and2x dark/light/teal, silhouette-only and isolated costume/hand/boot layers
actual imported texture and rendered visibleRGBA; fixed scale/camera/pivot and clear margins
Every new action/transition frame on fixed192 canvas, unchanged paint scale, common(+32,+64) registration and nominal[96,170] pivot; at least4px clear action/equipment border
clock_and_state: immediately before/at/after every rational event boundary
hit_start and hit_end crossed in same update: ordered once, no stale hitbox
takeoff/apex/land each once; completion, pause/resume, rate change and reset
buffered latest legal request; held input does not restart action
forced interruption closes hitboxes and clears owned effect clocks
collision sweep or equivalent simulation coverage when rendering skips active strike poses
explicit exceptional catch-up limit; no silently lost gameplay events
contact_and_root: actual whole-boot material during grounded attack and landing support
fractions inside held cels, source moving/displaced-foot negative controls
jump height independent of ground root and shadow
collision-constrained root preserved through transitions; round final draw origin once
acceptance: normal-speed user playback separate from decoded-sheet inspection
mechanical correctness does not approve new art
fresh source-bound visual approval before expanding action library

backlog: compatible modular equipment tracks and equipped action profiles
driver_example_limit: Installed clip_driver.gd demonstrates attack lock/frame events, not implemented jump. Its boundary epsilon is not the strict cumulative-boundary policy to copy blindly.

equipment_contract.compatibility: onehand, twohand and ranged motion profiles require explicit compatible body clips; art swap alone cannot change motion semantics
